screen: tuning menu gearing graph / Performance panel

held.ratiosNote: the game's own 7-speed race-box defaults, matching SPREAD[7] exactly; never altered during the sweep

readings.fitNote: final drive at which the top gear's line just reaches the right-hand edge of the gearing graph
readings.axisMaxNote: UNRESOLVED — see BACKLOG.md E2. Recorded twice off the same car and screen, 1.3% apart, and the whole gear-speed model hangs off it via k = axisMax * fit * topRatio. Read it once, cold, and write the number into this field.
readings.gearEndpointsNote: read off the chart at final drive 4.82; the check that k/(FD*G) holds across all seven gears
readings.fifthAtFd373Note: Top Speed readout with fd 3.73, rev-limited in 5th. This is an INDEPENDENT reading and it discriminates between the two axis candidates: k=596.5 predicts 145.38 (exact), k=589 predicts 143.55 (1.85 mph out). Only trust that as evidence if this figure was read off the screen rather than back-computed from 159 — establishing which is part of settling E2.

notes: Ratios held at the race-box default, final drive the only variable, no driving — every figure is Performance panel output. The performance columns are a fixture, NOT a model: at fd 3.50 and 4.82 the engine sits at 7551 and 7516 rpm at top speed (0.5% apart) while the implied drag differs by 9.7%, so six points on one car underdetermine the physics. Use these rows to check that a constant produces a setting the game liked; do not fit to them.
